description.value: South Silk Road is a Canadian restaurant group bringing authentic Southwest Chinese cuisine — rooted in the culinary traditions of Yunnan, Guizhou, Sichuan, and Hunan — to Richmond, BC. The menu emphasizes bold, complex flavors featuring chili, Sichuan peppercorn, fermented and pickled ingredients sourced from diverse regional traditions. The Richmond location is part of a three-city Canadian chain recommended by Alberta Tourism, with online ordering and table reservations available.
